name: Starlight Re:Volver
detailed_description:
THANK YOU - #10 MOST PLAYED DEMO OF STEAM NEXT FEST

Starlight Re:Volver was #10 in the most-played demos of June 2025's Steam Next Fest 🎊

To everyone who played our game, got their friends to play, gave us feedback, and joined our community – we are so grateful 💖

👾 Wishlist our game to get notified when our game releases! Early Access is coming this year.

💡 In Starlight Re:Volver, play as a magical Diver who possesses a special power to access dreams and retrieve their secrets and treasures. Our poster girl, Effy, is a girl who, time and time again, crashes through the gate of So Mi in search of the Starlight Revolver. Connect with other Divers and explore a vibrant anime-inspired city that will steal your heart.

Online Multiplayer Odyssey

🏙️ Get lost in Nishi Island Metropolis (NIM), a cutting-edge blue island paradise where science and magic swirl together. This bustling social MMO hub supports dozens of concurrent players where your Diver returns to craft, refuel, relax, and recruit new friends ahead of their next exhilarating adventure.

🌠 Dive into the gate to So Mi, rule-bent wilds filled with wonder and nostalgia. From floating islands to stellar space stations, each area of So Mi embodies a fantastical metaphor frozen in time. With of party of 4, embark on an expedition and collect materials and recipe scrolls to return home as celebrated heroes.

Social, Anime-Inspired World

🎏 Meet new friends while exploring NIM's social activities. Hoverboarding, fishing, star gazing, bug catching, grow a garden, crafting, and accessorizing, there’s no limit to the activities that earn you points towards your Diver's license.

🏡 Interact with NIM's residents who support beloved Divers with delicious cafe drinks, baked goods, fireworks and accessory upgrades after their expedition. Meet the shopkeeper, the blacksmith, the cafe owner, the royal prince, and the fishing instructor, listen to their tales and learn their persona.

🌦️ Experience fantasy life in NIM. Discover NIM's schedule at different time of day, experience daylight, nights, weather, rain, and seasons at key locations like Altair Academy and the Sakura Tree, and log your findings in your Diver's Codex.

No Limit to Team-Play Possibilities

👯‍♀️ Form a dream team of 4 trusted Divers to best your rivals and hack and slash your way through each of So Mi's distinctive roguelite dreamworlds. If you’re dead, your cooperative teammates can pop your bubble to bring you back to life!

🌱 Each biome has unique enemies and battlegrounds. From elder guardians of forgotten ages in ancient ruins, to tarot spirits of oblivion in dark gothic castles, and even mecha rocket cats of doom in stellar space stations.

✨ Discover a hundred new ability combinations that each offer a unique gameplay path. There is no last or final mission, each dive is a rematch where you can strategically shape your combat style, whether it's high risk or defense, elemental (Nova, Gaia, Luna, and Zena) or physical attack for any Diver.

Stunning Visuals and Signature Soundtrack

🎤 Encore! Get lost in Starlight Re:Volver’s nostalgic disco J-pop citypop OST featuring an unbeatable ring of music talent including Sarah Bonito (from Kero Kero Bonito), Miyolophone, LilyPichu, and more!

Letter from the Devs: About Pahdo Labs

Starlight Re:Volver is a split world fantasy co-op rogue-lite (or rogue-like) action RPG dungeon crawler, where our heroes — the Diver — enter the dreamlike world of So Mi. Bring a pal, because it takes a party of two to four divers to face the obscure monsters you will encounter. Our Divers want to reach the top 5 of the Diver league, write their legend, and leave a legacy.

Our creative guide line is “If we follow trends, we’ll be late to the punch. Instead, we’ll inform ourselves with patterns and themes from history, then create something from the heart.“ We hope that our characters are memorable and relevant: iconic characters that are deserving of cosplay and fanart, and used as benchmarks for future fiction.

We are a small New York based indie team of 33 game developers and anime fans, with DNA from Capcom, Bandai Namco, and Gaia Online. We were inspired by works like Sailor Moon, the roguelike Hades, Terraria, Runescape, and Maplestory, and aspire to rebirth the anime MMORPG in a modern way. Our product does not make any use of AI artwork or voiceover.

short_description: Starlight Re:Volver is a 1-4 player co-op action roguelite, set in a nostalgic, anime-inspired MMO universe. Connect with other Divers in the city and explore dreamlike biomes, teaming up for thrilling adventures, minigames, fishing, and crafting.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel I5 4690 / AMD FX 8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 950, Radeon R7 360, or Intel HD Graphics 630
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 8 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 10.15 (Catalina)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 (Quad-Core, 2.5 GHz or better)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro 555 / or Apple M1 integrated GPU
